modelTrace.title: Model check
modelTrace.description: Sends 3 "write down some numbers" prompts at once and judges which model the answers resemble most from their number preferences.
modelTrace.empty: Pick a channel and model on the left, then click "Start check".
modelTrace.target.none: Pick a channel and model on the left first.
modelTrace.warnings.gateway: When checking through the model gateway, the requests may be routed to different channels and their answers get mixed. To check one channel, switch Test mode to "Channel".
modelTrace.warnings.notCovered: "{{model}}" is not in the fingerprint bank (it only has {{count}} models: {{families}}). The result only says which bank model the answers resemble; it cannot tell whether the model is genuine.
modelTrace.notes.request: Check requests carry only the prompt: no system prompt, temperature or max tokens (those settings on the left apply to chat only). A check sends {{parallel}} requests at once and replaces failed or too-short answers with new prompts, {{max}} prompts at most; a rate-limited prompt is re-sent after a short wait, up to {{retries}} times. They are billed like chats and appear in the request logs.
modelTrace.notes.bias: Project prompt injection rules, channel parameter overrides and channels that add their own system prompt (such as Claude Code) can skew the result. This page also cannot see whether an answer was cut off by a token limit or a content filter (for example a small max_tokens in a channel override); such answers still count if they contain enough numbers.
modelTrace.probe.title: Request {{index}}
modelTrace.probe.numbers: {{parsed}} numbers found ({{expected}} asked, {{minimum}} needed to count)
modelTrace.run.title: {{time}} · {{target}} · {{model}}
modelTrace.result.lowConfidence: The top probability is below 60%, so this is uncertain. Try running the check again.
modelTrace.result.partial: Only {{used}} valid answers (target {{target}}), so the result is less certain.
modelTrace.result.footer: Based on {{used}} valid answers; with that many, the author's cross-validated accuracy is {{accuracy}}. Bank date {{date}}. For reference only, not proof.
modelTrace.verdict.match: Matches {{subject}}: the answers look most like {{model}} ({{probability}}).
modelTrace.verdict.sameFamily: Same family, different version: {{subject}} is {{claimed}}, but the answers look most like {{model}} ({{probability}}).
modelTrace.verdict.differentFamily: Different family: {{subject}} is {{claimedFamily}}'s {{claimed}}, but the answers look most like {{family}}'s {{model}} ({{probability}}).
modelTrace.verdict.notCovered: The model being checked is not in the fingerprint bank, so it cannot be verified; the answers look most like {{model}} ({{probability}}), for reference only.
modelTrace.history.title: Checks on this page
modelTrace.errors.noValid: No valid answers (errors, refusals or too few numbers), so there is nothing to judge.
modelTrace.errors.bank: Could not load the fingerprint bank: {{message}}
modelTrace.run.rateLimited: The channel is rate limiting, so the check slowed down: rate-limited prompts are re-sent later and fewer requests run at once.
modelTrace.verdict.subjectMapped: the model the channel actually requests
modelTrace.verdict.matchUnsure: Closest to {{subject}}, but only {{probability}} sure. Run the check again.
modelTrace.verdict.uncertain: The answers sit between model families, so there is no conclusion; the single closest model is {{model}} ({{probability}}). Try again.
modelTrace.errors.incomplete: The answer did not finish normally and is clearly short (probably cut off); not counted.
modelTrace.probe.unfinished: No end marker arrived, but nearly all numbers are there, so it counts as complete.
modelTrace.run.rateLimitedOut: The channel kept rate limiting, so the check stopped early. Try again later.
modelTrace.verdict.sameFamilyUnsure: Same family ({{family}}), but the version is unclear: the closest, {{model}}, is only {{probability}}.
